title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 475
text:
441 However, unmarried couples (whether gay or heterosexual), must show that they
are living as partners in an enduring family relationship.442
LGB asylum seekers

19. In 67 countries, same-sex relationships are illegal and can lead to lengthy prison sentences,
including 11 where the death penalty applies. There can be persecution even if the law is not
enforced. In some other countries, although homosexuality is not technically illegal, levels of
persecution and discrimination are high.443

20. People who face persecution on the basis of their real or perceived sexual orientation can
claim asylum in Britain.

439 The Civil Partnership (Opposite-sex Couples) Regulations 2019, SI 2019/1458; R (on the application of Steinfeld
and Keidan) v Secretary of State for International Development (in substitution for the Home Secretary and the
Education Secretary) [2018] UKSC 32.
